# GrowAssistant v0.2.0-beta.1

**Beta for controlled testing**, not a production native-irrigation activation
release. Planned Git tag: `v0.2.0-beta.1`; manifest version: `0.2.0-beta.1`.
These notes are prepared for a future GitHub prerelease; preparation does not
create a tag or publish a release.

## New development features

- **Phase 1 — Native PumpController:** bounded pump control and recovery handling
  for development fixtures. [Details](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-pump-controller.md).
- **Phase 2A — Irrigation decision engine:** native decision evaluation separated
  from execution. [Details](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-irrigation-decisions.md).
- **Phase 2B — Safe single-shot coordinator:** reservation, validation, bounded
  execution and accounting. [Details](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-shot-engine.md).
- **Phase 2C — Event-driven scheduler:** supervised event-driven scheduling with
  no catch-up replay. [Details](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-scheduler.md).
- **Phase 3A — Native phase and cycle management:** phase transitions, cycle
  identity and reset/reference handling. [Details](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-cycle.md).
- **Phase 3B — Safety, sensor validation and recovery diagnostics:** provisional
  freshness/quorum/disagreement checks, uncertain-delivery evidence and migration
  blockers. [Details](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-safety-migration.md).
- **Phase 3C — 12 read-only Home Assistant diagnostic entities:** live sensor
  assessment, historical recovery/last-shot evidence, ownership and migration
  status. [Entity reference](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-diagnostics.md).

## Compatibility

The existing Blueprint remains the production irrigation executor. Native
irrigation execution is disabled during normal Home Assistant setup: no native
execution controllers are initialized. There is no automatic migration or pump
activation. Existing configuration, entity IDs and unique IDs are preserved;
the diagnostic entities are additive. This preparation changes version metadata
and documentation only, with no integration behavior or new features.

## Known limitations

- No production activation interface.
- Pump ownership cannot yet be enforced against arbitrary external controllers.
- Independent hardware watchdog and physical pump-off verification remain outstanding.
- Native recovery and persistence limitations remain documented in the
  [safety and migration guide](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/native-safety-migration.md), including
  nontransactional options/journal persistence and mandatory review of uncertain
  delivery or restart evidence. Exactly-once durability is not claimed.
- Sensor safety defaults are provisional and require validation against actual
  hardware and sensor acquisition semantics; HA receipt timestamps are not proof
  of fresh physical measurements.
- Diagnostic journal snapshots are loaded during setup/reload, not continuously.
  Missing history and observed HA pump-off do not establish safety or ownership.

## Installation and beta testing

Make a **complete Home Assistant backup** before installation. Follow the
[HACS selection, beta checklist and rollback guide](https://github.com/TheFreakPinny/ha-growassistant-crop-steering/blob/main/docs/beta-testing.md).
Once separately published, select **`v0.2.0-beta.1` explicitly** with beta releases
shown in HACS; prereleases are not assumed to be automatic updates. Draft releases
and this preparation branch are not selectable releases. Do not enable native
irrigation. Previous stable rollback target: `v0.1.16` (or your recorded pre-beta
stable version).
